questions: Any history of seizures, convulsions or an epilepsy diagnosis
Epilepsy in a first-degree relative (parent, sibling, child)
Discomfort, dizziness or migraine ever triggered by flashing or flickering light (screens, strobes, sunlight through trees)
Current medication or substance known to lower the seizure threshold, or sleep deprivation today
Any neurological, psychiatric or eye condition not yet discussed with the study team
hello.warning: This device flashes light at 8-13 Hz. Flicker in this range can trigger seizures in people with photosensitive epilepsy, sometimes without any prior history. Stop immediately (STOP button or Esc) if the participant reports discomfort, visual disturbance, nausea or headache. Research and teaching use only. Not a medical device.
